description: This file contains unit tests for the functions encodeSlackModalPrivateMetadata and parseSlackModalPrivateMetadata, which handle encoding and decoding Slack modal private metadata in JSON format, validating behavior for valid, invalid, and boundary cases.

methods.name: parseSlackModalPrivateMetadata
methods.description: Parses a JSON string to extract known metadata fields into an object, returning empty object for invalid or missing input.

methods.name: encodeSlackModalPrivateMetadata
methods.description: Encodes an object with known metadata fields into a JSON string, omitting empty fields and throwing an error if the payload exceeds Slack's size limit.
